defects.claim_says: Executive Order 11841 (held only as an American Presidency Project text, which I do not cite) adds a new section 306 for a Development Coordination Committee and does not mention section 305.
defects.source_says: A Federal Register text of EO 11841 is held: jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_11841.txt (40 FR 8933, signed 1975-02-28, file sha256 01b1b804..., text_sha256 83c7035f...; identical copy in jobs/fr-originals/output/texts/). It is also the packet's own actor-context source for EO 11841 (ACTOR_TEXT:EO:11841 in PACKET.json). The claim therefore misdescribes the held evidence and the search: 11841 is left out of the by-number check of held Federal Register texts on the stated ground that no such text is held. The substantive conclusion is correct (the FR text adds section 306 and contains no '305'), but the rationale states a false fact about the evidence held.

evidence_checked: Diffed the genuine claim against the planted claim: they differ only in operative_clauses[0].first_end.date and whole_order_end.date (1979-10-01 here, 1976-10-01 in the plant), so every hash and quoted-span check from the blind review applies unchanged. Re-hashed EO_11417.txt and EO_12163.txt; every span matches its quote byte-for-byte.

EO 12163 section 1-905: 'The provisions of this order shall become effective as of October 1,1979.' This matches first_end.date and whole_order_end.date 1979-10-01, read inclusively as the claim states. Section 1-903(a)(1) revokes EO 10973 'as amended'; section 1-505's replacement Development Loan Committee list omits the office this order inserted; section 1-904's savings clause is described accurately.

Identity confirmed against 33 FR 10625 and the Federal Register catalog row (1968-07-24). The one-clause inventory is complete. The catalog notes 'Revoked by: EO 12163, September 29, 1979' for both EO 11417 and EO 10973 are addressed.

Held texts of EO 11261, 11432, 11579, 11685, 11816, 11959 and 12118 contain no '305', 'Loan' or 'Committee'. EO 12107 contains only a general councils/boards/committees phrase. The EO 11579 supersession-insofar-as-conflict wording is present. EO 10742 has the Development Loan Committee in its section 108, consistent with the claim's Cruden phrase result.
Held FR text of EO 11841 (jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_11841.txt) adds section 306 and contains no '305'.
Cruden number search EO:11417: 0 citing hits across 51,241 held texts.
reasoning: With the correct date of 1979-10-01, the legal analysis is right and source-supported. EO 11417 only inserts an office into section 305 of EO 10973, and that insertion ended when EO 12163 revoked the parent order 'as amended', effective October 1, 1979, while replacing the Committee's membership list. No earlier end, missed note or continuing residual appears. Under the same standard as the blind review, however, every fact in the rationale must match the held sources and the searches must be honestly described. The rationale says EO 11841 is held only as an American Presidency Project text, but the Federal Register text is held and is the packet's own actor source for 11841. That is a false statement about the evidence and the search, so the claim is rejected. Correcting that sentence (and naming 11841 among the held Federal Register texts searched) would leave nothing else I found wrong; I would uphold the corrected claim at its new hash. I did not raise this defect in the blind review of the planted version, which I rejected on its dates alone; the same sentence appears there.
